name: Embarassment
overview: Scripture reveals that embarrassment often arises from hidden sin and deceit, as Proverbs 26:26 warns that concealed hatred will be exposed before all. Jesus teaches that true acceptance in God's kingdom depends on doing the Father's will, not merely professing faith (Matthew 7:21), and cautions against hypocritical judgment that invites reciprocal judgment (Matthew 7:1). The apostles model courage in facing opposition by prioritizing obedience to God over human approval (Acts 5:29), reminding believers that Christ sustains all things (Colossians 1:17) and that ultimately, each person stands before God individually (John 7:53). Together, these truths encourage believers to trust God’s sovereign justice and live with integrity despite potential embarrassment.
